description: A Viet Nam wind-project inventory updated on 4 May 2022 contains 548 project-phase records, including 360 active phases and 215 with investment costs. Zenodo lists a public CSV, ODS, short data description and two small Python support files under CC BY 4.0. The provider documents stage, owner, location, onshore or offshore class, capacity, connection plan, turbine, investment and milestone fields, with one or more public sources per record. This could support wind-capacity pipeline scenarios or spatial electricity-grid planning. It is a historical inventory that includes exploration memoranda and inactive projects, so every listed capacity is not built or approved. Currency is VND or USD by record, requiring explicit conversion for cost comparisons. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this source-linked project-phase dataset. The files were not downloaded or executed, so record counts, links and current project status remain unverified.
